note: percentages describe explainer copy RECORDS, not verified biological repeats; differences may reflect candidate boundary or hypothesis changes, not only filtered sequence
axis_note: upstream_trigger says which pipeline stage changed; representation_outcome says whether the copy still appears in some form. They are independent: a copy whose window was excluded may still be re-represented from another window with shifted boundaries. Only no_corresponding_copy means the evidence is absent from the policy output, and even that is a computational evidence difference, not a verified biological miss.
